violation_type.title: Required posting of name, address, and telephone number - Local CCR office (26 TAC §746.405(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Required posting of name, address, and telephone number - Local CCR office
violation_type.typical_finding: The emergency telephone number posting included the incorrect telephone number for the local Child Care Regulation Office. This was corrected at inspection.
